summary: Verified M30 bug-fix: Match Calendar ground dropdown fallback + new Division Squad Detail page. Backend smoke tests via curl (grounds, squads, players) all pass. Frontend flows verified end-to-end for both DIV-IND (Devashish Nilosey) and MPCA (Sanjeev Dua) personas.

integration_issues.flow: SquadDetail · Add Player when tournament is Draft
integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'Pick' on a player when the tournament is still in Draft status returns backend 400 ('Cannot modify squad once tournament is Draft'). The error is caught into `err` state but the picker dialog stays open and does NOT surface the error inline in the picker — user sees no feedback. The [data-testid='squad-inline-error'] renders only on the underlying SquadDetail page which is covered by the modal. Recommend showing the error inside the picker dialog OR closing the picker+scrolling to inline-error. Not blocking (backend rule is correct — tournament must be Accepted before roster edits).

action_items: OPTIONAL UX polish: surface the backend 400 (e.g. 'Cannot modify squad once tournament is Draft') inside the [data-testid='squad-picker-dialog'] so DIV-IND users understand why picks are silently failing on a Draft tournament.

OPTIONAL: React hydration warning in Match Calendar <select> — a lovable-annotation <span> is injected inside <option> for 'ground_name' expression, causing a console 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning. Cosmetic (dev-only), does not affect the dropdown behaviour.
critical_code_review_comments: SquadDetail.jsx bootstrap logic when landing on /squads/:sid does a hidden GET /squads/{sid}/recommendation just to discover tournament_id, and if that fails falls back to iterating every scoped tournament and calling fetchSquads() on each — this is O(N) network requests. Consider adding a dedicated GET /api/squads/{sid} endpoint that returns {tournament_id, ...squad} in one call.

SquadDetail.jsx loadPlayersForSquad: for DIV- prefixed body_ids it fetches `/players?limit=2000` (unscoped) and filters client-side by suffix. That works but leaks non-scope players over the wire and is fragile if suffixes ever collide (e.g. new 3-letter code that ends in 'IND'). Prefer a backend param like `?parent_body_id=DIV-IND` that returns DIV + child-district players.

TournamentWorkspacePanels MatchCalendarPanel useEffect fallback fetch dep array uses `tournament?.setup_meta` (object identity) — this may re-fire more often than intended. Consider depending on a serialized owners key instead.
